rounds.text: The evidence reveals clear top-line stagnation, with compounded sales growth over 3 years dropping into negative territory at -2% [E16], alongside a trailing twelve-month sales growth rate of just 4% [E17]. This top-line slowdown sits beneath a stock carrying an annualized volatility of 54.4% [E54] and a price currently trading below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E50]. Furthermore, the dividend yield stands at a meager 0.24% [E4], offering minimal cash return to shareholders while expectations have run ahead of delivery, evidenced by price growth outpacing profit growth over a 5-year period [E56]. Conceded: the business has delivered a strong 10-year compounded sales growth rate of 25% and a robust 10-year compounded profit growth rate of 42% [E14, E18]. Nevertheless, the short-term revenue deceleration and weak momentum indicators expose investors to heightened downside risk should cyclical tailwinds fade [E16, E17, E50, E58].
